notes.title: BirdGut's (Probably) Final Update + What's Next (Fest)
notes.content:
Hello BirdGut players!

I wanted to fix up a few of the remaining bugs that I have been made aware of before I officially move on from BirdGut. Lots of the inner workings of the game are tangled messes of janky code, since it was made by a younger and much less experienced version of me, but I did what I could. Here's some of what I fixed:

1. That softblock in the very beginning next to the thimble mushroom
2. That atrocious glitch where the gun disappears if you save/load
3. a few smaller things...

Also, I updated the old graphical assets on steam, so BirdGut should look a lot nicer in your library now...

BUT WAIT, THERE'S MORE!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34949529/185cc9428b72cbc9a69446b47c49b81268c400fc.jpg[/img]

I also just wanted to give you another update on that next new thing I've been working on... 

Specifically, I want to let you all know to keep an eye out in this week's NextFest event (Oct 3 - Oct 10), because there is a demo of the project available for you to play for free!

So look for my new game called "The Multi-Medium!"

notes.title: Another Update!
notes.content:
Hello again,
After reading more feedback and watching more playthroughs, it has come to my attention that my game is quite a bit harder than I intended. In this update, I hope to ease some unnecessary frustration, as well as fix a few bugs.

Changes include:
[list]
[*] The "Must Be This Talented" ride is a little easier now
[*] The venus fly traps are a little slower
[*] There is no more lag in the bolt/screw laser drop part (also fewer lasers)
[*] Removed the glitch where you get stuck floating in the air after the colon
[*] Added a pipe to the large intestines so you can't get stuck after reloading
[*] Fixed a few other saving and layering issues
[/list]
Thanks again for all the helpful feedback and support, you're all awesome!

P.S. for speedrunners, the railcart still takes the same amount of time, the only new time-saver is the pipe in the large intestines.

notes.title: Bug Fix Update!
notes.content:
Hello all,
I've been watching over the community and playthroughs online, and gathering a list of bugs. Here's a patch that should fix many of them!

Included:
[list]
[*]New Music from Taylor Baum and Miguel Arada to fill the quiet
[*]A shorter respawn time
[*]Solved the crane crates, trash cart, leaf, missile cap and elevator soft locks.
[*]Removed the checkpoint that lets you skip the camera guns in Stomach City
[*]You can't go out of bounds on top of the hive anymore, sorry
[*]Fixed several sprite layering issues
[*]And more
[/list]

Thank you all for the kind words and helpful feedback. I am blessed to have such a friendly group of people playing my game.
